title: Jeweled Scepter of Sargeras
wikitext:
{{Stub}}A powerful artifact of the [[Dark Titan]] [[Sargeras]], used by him to channel dark energies to open [[portal]]s to new worlds. A [[Daemon]] on the [[Shattered Isles]] held the Scepter until it was killed by [[Ner'zhul]]'s henchmen. Without Sargeras to wield it, Ner'Zhul needed the [[Skull of Gul'dan]] for energy, the [[Book of Medivh]] for the knowledge of how to open a portal and the [[Eye of Dalaran]] to secure the planet. The Scepter was used to channel the energies of the Skull using the incantations from the Book, but without the Eye, the portals tore the planet apart. [[Khadgar]] destroyed the Scepter (along with [[Teron Gorefiend]]) a few days before he destroyed the portal.
